title: School of Mathematics and Statistics, Guilin University of Technology, Guilin 541004, ChinaScott spaces of complete Boolean algebras need not be co-sober
summary: In this paper, we first prove that for a complete Boolean algebra $L$, the complement graph of $L$ is a \emph{KC}-space (as a subspace) and each non-singleton compact irreducible subspace of that graph generates a non-principal $k$-irreducible compact saturated set in the Scott space of the square algebra $L\times L$. We then show that every compact sequential \emph{US}-space embeds into the complement graph of a suitable complete Boolean algebra. The embedding is built from a finite tail-constraint poset and its regular-open completion. Applying the construction to van Douwen's compact…
